sources.content: # Yolvane agent notes. Yolvane is a Rust library that parses and writes YAML-like config files while keeping comments and key order. The minimum Rust version is 1.75. Run `cargo test --all-features` before every push. Parser code lives in `src/parse/` and the writer in `src/emit/`. Round-trip fixtures are in `tests/roundtrip/`, one input file and one expected file per case. Do not use `unsafe` anywhere in the crate; the build sets `#![forbid(unsafe_code)]`.

Conventions. Every parse error carries a line and column, and its message starts with a lowercase letter and has no trailing period. Public API changes need an entry in `CHANGELOG.md` under Unreleased. The crate has exactly two optional features, `serde` and `chrono`, and neither is on by default. Fuzz the parser with `cargo fuzz run parse` for at least 10 minutes after touching `src/parse/lexer.rs`. Benchmarks use criterion and run with `cargo bench`.

claims.text: The Yolvane serde feature is off by default.
Yolvane forbids unsafe code in the crate.
Yolvane round-trip fixtures are in tests/roundtrip/.
The minimum Rust version for Yolvane is 1.70.
Yolvane parse errors carry a line and a column.
